sentences.text: Subsidy on Rehri alongwith (Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensil etc.) for the Fish/Fish Product Sale

**Scheme Brief Description:** Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided for purchase of a handcart along with essential items such as stove, gas chulha, utensils, etc., for fish and fish product sales. A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- will be granted, amounting to ₹36,000/- per beneficiary.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment

**Detailed Description:** The scheme “Subsidy on Rehri along with Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensils, etc. for Sale of Fish/Fish Products” is implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste fish farmers for the purchase of a Rehri (handcart) equipped with stove, gas chulha, utensils, and other essentials for selling fish and fish products. A 60% subsidy is provided on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- per beneficiary.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided for the purchase of a Rehri (Handcart) along with essential items such as stove, gas chulha, utensils, etc., for selling fish or fish products. - A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- will be granted, amounting to ₹36,000/- per beneficiary.
**Exclusions / Not eligible:** 1. The applicant should not be a Government/Semi-Government employee.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number &amp; password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile. > **Login to Apply for the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on &quot;Submit&quot;. > **Track Your Service Online:** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx). > **Track Your Service Through SMS:** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL&lt;space&gt;&lt;Application ID/Ticket No.&gt; and send to 9954699899 to track your application. > **Contact Us:** **Helpline:** 0172-3968400 **Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in > **Note:** > **Govt. Charges:** No Fee > **Service Charges:** ₹ 10 > **Atal Seva Kendra Service Charges:** ₹ 10
**Additional Application Processes:** **Process 2:** The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Atal Seva Kendra with all the required documents to apply for the scheme.
**Tags:** Fish, Fish Products, Subsidy, Handcart, Scheduled Caste, Fish Farmer
